title: How I measure product outcomes
subtitle: Seven Mixpanel boards: north stars, journey mapping and action thresholds. Dashboard values are synthetic demo data.
disclaimer: DEMO DATA · SYNTHETIC. All Mixpanel values are synthetic demo data, not real product performance. Thresholds are proposed starting points.

method.label: Objective
method.text: What outcome the product must move

method.label: North star
method.text: One metric that proves that outcome

method.label: Input metrics
method.text: Journey events, funnels and retention that feed it

method.label: Thresholds
method.text: Green / Watch / Act bands that force a decision

method.label: Action
method.text: What to change when a band is breached

apps.name: Agent Val
apps.summary: Agentic exploit validation inside Qualys ETM: nudge, autonomy mode, scope, TruConfirm validation, remediation, revalidation

howDecided.problem: Security teams know their findings but not which ones an attacker can exploit right now
howDecided.workflow: Closed loop: nudge on Vulnerabilities page, pick autonomy mode, select CVE and assets, run TruConfirm, remediate, revalidate
howDecided.approach: One event per loop step with properties (autonomy_mode, result, option, status), then absolutes, medians, funnels and retention on top

mapping.metric: North star: risks closed, TruRisk reduced

objectives.title: Prove risk is closed
objectives.text: Confirmed risks closed and TruRisk points reduced per week are the outcome Agent Val exists to deliver

objectives.title: Find adoption leaks
objectives.text: Nudge-to-validation funnel shows where users stop before the agent can help

objectives.title: Keep the loop fast
objectives.text: Median time from confirmed risk to closed tracks the speed promise

objectives.title: Earn trust
objectives.text: Feedback, evidence views and mode overrides show whether users trust the agent

apps.action: Red on failure or retention: review remediation playbooks for technology customers and add a weekly re-engagement nudge

value.text: Shows which loop step to fix next and lets Cost of Delay rank fixes by risk closed
Shows where remediation fails, by industry and option, before customers escalate
TruRisk points reduced is a customer-facing ROI number for renewals and expansion

images.alt: Agent Val Product Metrics dashboard: weekly active users, validations run, risk confirmation rate and adoption funnel
Agent Val Product Metrics dashboard: autonomy mix, remediation outcomes and weekly retention

apps.name: AI SOC Portal
apps.northStar: Alerts resolved end-to-end (per alert) and time to resolve
apps.summary: AI-assisted security operations: alert triage, incident response and AI recommendations for SOC analysts

howDecided.problem: SOCs face high alert volume, many false positives and slow response
howDecided.workflow: Alert viewed → triaged (true / false positive) → incident created → resolved, with AI analysis requested along the way
howDecided.approach: Count work per alert (hold alert_id), use median and P90 for time, and measure AI acceptance and feedback

mapping.metric: Alerts worked per day, daily active analysts
Time to resolve P50/P90 by severity
AI requests, acceptance rate by type

objectives.title: Count alerts, not analysts
objectives.text: Per-alert triage funnel measures conversion on the work object

objectives.title: Measure end-to-end flow
objectives.text: End-to-end funnel and median time to convert track resolution

objectives.title: Cut false-positive load
objectives.text: False positive rate shows how much triage effort is wasted

objectives.title: Prove AI helps
objectives.text: AI acceptance and positive feedback show whether recommendations reduce analyst burden

apps.action: Red on false positives: tune noisiest source systems and feed false-positive labels back to the triage model

value.text: Verifies the pitch claims (faster response, fewer false positives) with measured trends
Time to resolve by severity shows where staffing or playbooks are the bottleneck
AI acceptance and feedback turn AI adoption into a reportable efficiency story

images.alt: AI SOC Portal operations dashboard: daily active analysts, alerts worked and triage funnel
AI SOC Portal operations dashboard: time to convert, false positive rate and AI feedback

apps.name: AI-SPM
apps.northStar: Active accounts running risk assessments every week
apps.summary: AI Security Posture Management: discover AI assets, assess risk, detect policy violations and stay compliant

howDecided.problem: CISOs lack an inventory of AI assets and a way to quantify AI risk for the board
howDecided.workflow: Sign up → onboard → register AI assets → connect integrations → run risk assessments → handle violations and alerts → invite team
howDecided.approach: Follow the lifecycle: activation funnel, core-action volume, alert resolution speed, then weekly retention on risk assessments

mapping.metric: Activation funnel with time to convert
Assets by type and risk level
Assessments over time by risk level
Alert time to resolve, resolution by type
Invites by role, integrations by platform

objectives.title: Activate new accounts
objectives.text: Activation funnel shows whether signups reach a first registered asset

objectives.title: Build a weekly habit
objectives.text: Weekly retention on risk assessments is the core-value retention signal

objectives.title: Respond fast to alerts
objectives.text: Median and P90 time to resolve by severity keep critical alerts first

objectives.title: Show account growth
objectives.text: Weekly active users and team invites show expansion inside accounts

apps.action: Red on activation: add a guided first-asset registration in onboarding and alert on any signup with no asset after 24h

value.text: Pinpoints the onboarding step blocking activation, the biggest lever on growth
Compliance exports by framework give audit-ready evidence of coverage
Asset inventory, violations and team growth give a board-level AI risk view

images.alt: AI-SPM Analytics dashboard: signups, assets, risk assessments and activation funnel
AI-SPM Analytics dashboard: assets by type and risk, assessments over time, violations by type

apps.name: AI Policy Foundry
apps.northStar: Median time from policy draft to enforcement
apps.summary: Multi-agent cloud security policy generation with human approval gates and compliance validation

howDecided.problem: Manual policy creation takes weeks per cloud service, leaving multi-week security gaps
howDecided.workflow: Policy drafted → submitted for review → approved → published → enforced; exemptions requested and approved; compliance checks run
howDecided.approach: Lifecycle funnel per policy (hold policy_id), cycle time, exemption and compliance pass rates, plus user satisfaction

objectives.title: Deliver the 24h promise
objectives.text: Draft-to-enforced time tests the pitch claim of policies in under 24 hours

objectives.title: Keep humans in control
objectives.text: Review and approval steps in the funnel show where approvals stall

objectives.title: Prove compliance coverage
objectives.text: Pass rate by framework shows audit readiness

objectives.title: Track user sentiment
objectives.text: NPS by tier and weekly retention show whether engineers rely on the tool

apps.action: Red on cycle time: break down draft→enforced by step to find the slow approval gate, then add SLA reminders to reviewers

value.text: Turns the faster-policy claim into a measured cycle-time trend
Shows which frameworks fail most often so policy templates can be fixed
Pass rates and exemption trends give evidence for audits and risk committees

images.alt: AI Policy Foundry dashboard: policy lifecycle funnel and exemption approval rate
AI Policy Foundry dashboard: NPS detail by score, feature, aspect and tier

apps.name: Ellyra Pulse
apps.northStar: NPS (% promoters − % detractors) with zero unrouted safety signals
apps.summary: NPS and sentiment intelligence for a medical AI companion, with safety-gated feedback routing

howDecided.problem: A dip in NPS can mean a UI annoyance or a clinical-trust failure, and today they look the same
howDecided.workflow: Patient uses an AI companion → feedback captured → safety gate and PHI redaction → routing → clinical review and closed loop
howDecided.approach: Separate volume from severity: NPS by feature, aspect and tier, safety-flag routing, incident lifecycle and AI acceptance

mapping.metric: NPS, NPS by feature and aspect

objectives.title: Measure trust correctly
objectives.text: True NPS (promoters − detractors) replaces the average score

objectives.title: Route safety fast
objectives.text: Safety flags and per-alert triage time track clinical response

objectives.title: Activate clinical teams
objectives.text: Activation funnel shows whether teams reach a first analysis

objectives.title: Find the weakest feature
objectives.text: NPS by feature and aspect show where trust erodes first

apps.action: Any safety flag spike above 2× the 7-day average pages clinical on-call; red NPS triggers a feature-level root-cause review

value.text: Shows which AI companion needs work first
Safety flags and triage time prove signals reach a human within minutes
One trusted view of patient trust instead of three teams reading NPS differently

images.alt: Ellyra Pulse dashboard: average NPS, responses over time and NPS by feature, aspect and tier
Ellyra Pulse dashboard: share of responses by tier and weekly retention

apps.name: Agritech Crop Insurance
apps.northStar: Hours from payout trigger to money in the farmer's hands
apps.summary: CropGuard: parametric drought insurance for Indian farmers over WhatsApp and voice in regional languages

howDecided.problem: Claims take 90+ days; paperwork and language barriers exclude smallholder farmers
howDecided.workflow: Farmer onboards on WhatsApp/voice → requests quote → buys policy → sends field photo + location → rainfall trigger fires → payout
howDecided.approach: Two-sided view: farmer funnel and payout speed, plus insurer console activity and channel health by language

mapping.metric: Purchase funnel; buys by channel, language, crop
Payout pipeline funnel, time to payout

objectives.title: Pay farmers fast
objectives.text: Median and P90 time to payout test the settlement target

objectives.title: Reach farmers in their language
objectives.text: Purchases by channel and language show WhatsApp vs voice reach

objectives.title: Verify claims cleanly
objectives.text: Location pin attach rate exposes geo-verification friction

objectives.title: Keep insurers engaged
objectives.text: Insurer DAU and claim approval rate track the other side of the market

apps.action: Red on payouts: fix farmer identity across steps so funnels connect, then alert when any payout exceeds 24h

value.text: Shows whether the claim promise holds and where the payout pipeline breaks
Insurer DAU, evidence inspection and approval rates size review workload
Channel and language mix guide expansion to new states and crops

images.alt: Agritech Crop Insurance dashboard: farmer acquisition and policy purchase funnel
Agritech Crop Insurance dashboard: payout pipeline, triggers and field evidence

apps.name: AI Defence Ecosystem
apps.northStar: Policy compliance rate and draft-to-enforced time across the AI estate
apps.summary: Executive umbrella across AI-SPM, AI SOC and AI Policy Foundry: is our AI estate secure, governed and monitored?

howDecided.problem: Leaders need one answer across three products instead of reading three boards
howDecided.workflow: Discover and assess AI assets (SPM) → detect and respond to threats (SOC) → govern with policies and compliance (Policy Foundry)
howDecided.approach: One or two signals per pillar plus cross-pillar adoption, each defined the same way as on the pillar boards

mapping.metric: Checks passed vs failed, pass rate

objectives.title: Answer one question
objectives.text: Is the AI estate secure, governed and actively monitored?

objectives.title: Show governance speed
objectives.text: Draft-to-enforced median is the headline governance KPI

objectives.title: Keep backlogs in check
objectives.text: Incidents created vs resolved and checks passed vs failed show backlog growth

objectives.title: Track platform adoption
objectives.text: WAU per pillar shows whether all three products are used together

apps.action: Red rows are partly data-definition issues: fix the containment and exemption formulas before using them in exec reviews

value.text: One board to prioritise across three products using the same definitions
Answers 'secure, governed, monitored?' in one view for board and regulator updates
Cross-pillar adoption supports a platform story and bundled pricing
